name: Schneeberger India Pvt. Ltd
india_angle: SCHNEEBERGER India will participate in SEMICON India 2026, showcasing precision motion technology for semiconductor applications.
summary: Schneeberger India Pvt. Ltd provides precision motion solutions including linear guideways and integrated measuring systems, which are crucial for semiconductor equipment manufacturing. Their offerings are tailored to meet the high precision and reliability demands of the semiconductor industry.
